note: Do not instantiate directly; use itasca.geometry.edge module functions.

methods.name: closest
methods.description: Return the point on the edge closes to the point pos.

methods.name: dir
methods.description: Get the geometry edge edge dirction (vector).

methods.name: dir_x
methods.description: Get the x-component of the geometry edge edge dirction.

methods.name: dir_y
methods.description: Get the y-component of the geometry edge edge dirction.

methods.name: dir_z
methods.description: Get the z-component of the geometry edge edge dirction.

methods.name: extra
methods.description: Get the geometry edge extra data in the given slot.

methods.name: group
methods.description: Get the geometry edge group name in a given slot.

methods.name: group_remove
methods.signature: edge.group_remove(group_name: str or int[, slot: str or int]) -> bool
methods.description: Remove from the given group from all group slots of the geometry edge. One argument of type string, giving the group name, is required. The return value is a bool which is True if the group was removed from any slot, otherwise False.

methods.name: groups
methods.description: Get a dictionary describing which groups this geometry edge is part of. The keys of the dictionary are the slot names and the values are the group names.

methods.name: id
methods.description: Get the geometry edge id.

methods.name: in_group
methods.signature: edge.in_group(group_name: str or int[, slot: str or int]) -> bool
methods.description: Test if the geometry edge is part of a given group. If the optional argument slot is given, only that slot is searched. Otherwise, all group slots are searched.

methods.name: length
methods.description: Get the edge legnth.

methods.name: next_edge
methods.description: Get the next edge connected to the node with local index i within the source edge.

methods.name: next_index
methods.description: Get the local index of the point within the next edge connected to this point(the same point with local index i within the source edge).

methods.name: node
methods.description: Get an edge node with the local index i.

methods.name: node_pos
methods.description: Get the position of an edge node with the local index i.

methods.name: pos
methods.description: Get the geometry edge location (vector).

methods.name: pos_x
methods.description: Get the x-component of the geometry edge location.

methods.name: pos_y
methods.description: Get the y-component of the geometry edge location.

methods.name: pos_z
methods.description: Get the z-component of the geometry edge location.

methods.name: set_extra
methods.description: Set the geometry edge extra data in the given slot.

methods.name: set_group
methods.signature: edge.set_group(group_name: str or int[, slot: str or int]) -> None
methods.description: Set the geometry edge group name in a given slot.

methods.name: start_index
methods.description: Get the local index of the geometry edge within the first edge attached to it.

methods.name: start_poly
methods.description: Get the first polygon connected to a geometry edge.

methods.name: valid
methods.description: Returns True if this geometry edge is live.
